verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation and company-setup service, and such a service could plausibly offer a test or sandbox mode, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment for Atlas. The docs cover only real incorporation, EIN, 83(b) filing, banking and fundraising flows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
